name: montis-icu-coach
description: Montis.icu Coach analyzes authorized Intervals.icu training, activity, wellness, and performance data to provide governed endurance reports, insights, and training-plan workflows.

interface.longDescription: Montis.icu Coach is a data-analysis plugin for endurance athletes and coaches. It analyzes authorized Intervals.icu training, activity, wellness, performance, and calendar data to generate governed reports and insights, review completed activities, build training plans, and safely manage planned calendar events.
defaultPrompt: Review my wellness and recommend what to do next.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Expands the Plan Builder with governed race plans for Nordic skiing, triathlon, duathlon and rowing; adds 5K, ultrarunning and XC MTB events, race-season handling, training-model selection, race-load estimation, and deterministic sport-specific reconciliation. The production MCP and CIMD OAuth configuration are unchanged.
